actions.description: Inspect verified dependency manifests, local host capability, free loopback ports, target ownership and absence without creating directories.

actions.onUnknown: freeze; inspect original PID/files/journal; never repeat --initialize, clear data or infer rollback

actions.description: Verify vendor initialization produced usable private ca.pem/server-cert.pem/server-key.pem. If absent or incompatible stop; never disable TLS.

actions.onUnknown: retain original ownership and evidence; do not start another server

actions.description: Use the vendor-created localhost administrative identity only in this private instance. Rotate its expired temporary password before CREATE/GRANT; feed approved SQL through stdin, with no client --force.

actions.onUnknown: freeze and inspect exact account/schema state under this original instance; never rerun CREATE/GRANT blindly or adopt IF NOT EXISTS

actions.description: Import this instance CA into a new private PKCS12 store using the portable approved JDK21 keytool. Never download a trust store or expose store password in argv.

actions.onUnknown: retain ownership and occupied instance; do not start replacement
